C01_S01.summary: Daniel consults UWF; Vera learns to define facts rather than allege guilt.

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: Northbridge gave me a dismissal notice. It says my position is being removed. Yesterday they advertised a job that sounds like mine.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: What does the notice say about the reason? Not what you think they meant—what they actually wrote.

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: “Work shortage following reorganisation.” Apparently the shortages do not extend to people who can do my work.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: That may be important. We need to separate the notice, the advertised vacancy, and Daniel’s account of what he does.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Then I want the documents. And Daniel, you decide how your personal claim is handled—not the loudest person in this office.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.prompt: What should Vera record as the opening issue?

options.label: The stated work-shortage reason and Daniel’s reported vacancy
The vacancy proves the dismissal was unlawful
Other Northbridge employees must agree with Daniel

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Two separate claims to investigate: an issued notice and a vacancy Daniel believes overlaps with his job.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: The vacancy is a lead, not yet a legal finding. We need the actual duties and other relevant circumstances.

nodes.speaker: SALLY_DARITY
nodes.text: We have heard Daniel’s account. Do not put words into his colleagues’ mouths.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: We move forward with the facts, permissions and decisions as actually recorded.

C01_S02.summary: Daniel supplies dismissal notice and contract independently; individual-use permissions.

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: This is the notice they gave me. The contract is here too. I kept both, even after they told me the decision was settled.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Good. Two documents, two sources. We record who supplied each and exactly what we can disclose.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: The notice gives Northbridge’s stated reason. The contract shows your agreed employment terms; neither answers the vacancy question alone.

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: The contract has my address and salary. Do we need to show all of that to their lawyer?

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: No. We will minimise what we present and record the permitted purpose. A case file is not public property.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.prompt: Which part of the employment papers belongs in the negotiation file?

options.label: The authenticated passages relevant to Daniel’s employment
Every private detail, because it is in the contract
A general release of Daniel’s claims

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Use the relevant clauses and record the source. Keep unrelated personal data out of the presentation.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: More paper is not better evidence. We do not need to circulate Daniel’s address to explain his role.

nodes.speaker: SALLY_DARITY
nodes.text: Nobody has proposed an authorised settlement, and Daniel has not instructed us to release claims.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Before we quote the notice, check whether Daniel supplied the complete signed version.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: The notice is verified for use. Quote the employer’s stated reason and operative wording only.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Record the source, purpose and authorised recipients. Nothing further is implied.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: We cannot establish the notice’s exact contents from an unverified copy.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Record the missing source as a gap and use an independent route if available.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Daniel’s contract matters for his employment terms; we do not need to parade his private details.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: The authenticated contract supports the relevant employment terms—not what vacancies Northbridge had.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Record the source, purpose and authorised recipients. Nothing further is implied.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Without an authenticated relevant copy we should not state the contractual terms as proven.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Record the missing source as a gap and use an independent route if available.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: We move forward with the facts, permissions and decisions as actually recorded.

C01_S03.summary: Request and authenticate organisation chart; information-gap fallback.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: This is the proposed chart Northbridge circulated. I cannot find Daniel’s box on it.

nodes.speaker: JULIAN_VANE
nodes.text: A box disappearing is not the same thing as work disappearing, Ms Justice.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Then let us have the version date, the approval status, and a record of what work moved to the new team.

nodes.speaker: JULIAN_VANE
nodes.text: You want the decorative arrows explained?

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Precisely. Once we know what the arrows actually represent, we can make a claim that survives scrutiny.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.prompt: What is the safest reading of the proposed chart?

options.label: Identify which structure and version it actually shows
Declare that every change has already been implemented
Treat all employees as approving the reorganisation

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: This shows a proposed structure. We still need the approval status and the movement of actual duties.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: A draft may be significant evidence, but a draft is not automatically an implemented decision.

nodes.speaker: SALLY_DARITY
nodes.text: A management chart records no employee vote or individual consent.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Ask which chart was circulated, when, and whether it was only a proposal.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: We can rely on this dated chart for the structure it actually shows.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Record the source, purpose and authorised recipients. Nothing further is implied.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: An unsigned, undated chart cannot establish the proposed structure for negotiation.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Record the missing source as a gap and use an independent route if available.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: We move forward with the facts, permissions and decisions as actually recorded.

C01_S04.summary: Record Daniel’s goals and specific individual instructions; no blank cheque to settle.

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: I do not want to win an argument and lose my job in the process.

nodes.speaker: SALLY_DARITY
nodes.text: If Northbridge offers you a different role, what would you need to know before you considered it?

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: The actual duties, pay, where I would work—and whether they expect me to sign something that gives up every claim I have.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: We will ask, and we will not accept individual terms on your behalf without your informed instructions for those terms.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Our authority to negotiate for UWF is a separate question. Neither authority can be borrowed from the other.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.prompt: Which instruction should Vera write into Daniel’s file?

options.label: Discuss proposals; ask Daniel before accepting individual terms
Promise to accept the next role offered
Authorise a union-wide agreement in Daniel’s name

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Daniel asks to review actual duties and terms before any individual agreement. We will record that limit.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Daniel has not approved an unspecified vacancy or its conditions.

nodes.speaker: SALLY_DARITY
nodes.text: One worker’s instructions cannot confer collective acceptance authority on UWF.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: We move forward with the facts, permissions and decisions as actually recorded.

C01_S05.summary: P01 position overlap: compare actual duties, not merely job titles.

nodes.text: The advertised role lists most of Daniel’s duties, but gives them a new title. That seems remarkably convenient.

nodes.text: A convenient coincidence is not a legal finding. What tasks and qualifications can we compare?

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Then our question is concrete: which duties continue, what qualifications are genuinely needed, and what alternatives were considered?

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: A new name on a door will not tell us whether Daniel should have been considered for the vacancy.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.prompt: What is the legally useful comparison?

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE

nodes.text: A label alone can neither prove nor defeat the point.

nodes.speaker: SALLY_DARITY
nodes.text: Changing a heading is not a substitute for examining what employees actually do.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: The vacancy advertisement may show what Northbridge was recruiting for; save the full dated posting.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: The dated advertisement documents a vacancy as described, not Daniel’s entitlement to it.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Record the source, purpose and authorised recipients. Nothing further is implied.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: An unverified screenshot cannot establish when or whether this job was open.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Record the missing source as a gap and use an independent route if available.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Record the source, purpose and authorised recipients. Nothing further is implied.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Without the authenticated description we cannot safely compare the complete new role.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Record the missing source as a gap and use an independent route if available.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Compare the advertised role against Daniel’s duties line by line.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Compare duties, skills and vacancy requirements—not job labels alone.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.prompt: Which conclusion does the case record justify?

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: The authenticated records establish a material duty overlap, which warrants a documented reassignment assessment.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: The authenticated records establish a material duty overlap, which warrants a documented reassignment assessment.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: That conclusion exceeds the available sources. Use a narrower finding instead.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: That conclusion exceeds the available sources. Use a narrower finding instead.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: The gap is an unanswered requirement, not a score against either side.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Start with the systems Daniel actually maintains, not the job titles.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Look for the advertised requirements and which ones the verified records address.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: If duties match but key qualifications are unknown, report limited overlap; if the record is too thin, report the evidence gap.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: The conclusion and any remaining uncertainty are now recorded for the next stage.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: We move forward with the facts, permissions and decisions as actually recorded.

C01_S06.summary: Frame negotiating questions and verify initial local authority.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Before we sit across from Northbridge, I want three questions answered: what changed, what vacancies exist, and who decided Daniel was unsuitable.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: I can question their documents, but I cannot promise Daniel a deal.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Correct. Verify the authorised UWF appointment and keep Daniel’s individual instructions in a separate record.

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: If they offer me something, bring it back to me first. I do not want to discover my consent in the minutes.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Agreed. Today is about authorised questions, not a signature made out of impatience.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE

Daniel’s permission to decide all collective matters

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Commitment is welcome. Authority must still be granted and recorded.

nodes.speaker: SALLY_DARITY
nodes.text: Daniel may instruct us about his own case; that does not appoint the union’s collective decision-making body.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: We move forward with the facts, permissions and decisions as actually recorded.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: We have not verified UWF’s authority for this negotiation. We must examine an actual appointment or obtain an authorised decision before we meet the employer.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE

options.label: Request a decision from the authorised UWF body

nodes.note: This action requests verification and does NOT automatically grant authority.

nodes.text: The record is incomplete. We ask Northbridge for a specific role-by-role explanation.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: We have identified the reassignment dispute. Now we read the proposed terms word for word.

nodes.speaker: SUP_NORTHBRIDGE_REP
nodes.text: Northbridge offers Daniel an interview for the advertised position, provided he signs a full and final waiver of claims arising from the restructuring.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: An interview does not resolve a dismissal notice, and the waiver is broader than Daniel has authorised us to discuss.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Then we need a narrower written offer. We will show Daniel every individual clause and verify what the union can accept for itself.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.prompt: Northbridge wants a broad waiver in exchange for an interview. What should Vera do?

options.label: Reject the blanket waiver and request precise revised terms
Ask whether an interview alone settles the dismissal

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Daniel has not instructed us to release all claims. An unbounded waiver cannot be accepted on his behalf.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: No. An interview is a step in an assessment, not automatically a remedy for an existing dismissal notice. We need the written proposal.

nodes.speaker: JULIAN_VANE
nodes.text: Very well. Northbridge is prepared to put a narrower written package on the table, without an admission that its original decision was unlawful.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Clause 1 — Northbridge withdraws its June 10 dismissal notice to Daniel in writing. His existing employment and contractual pay continue; the withdrawal is not conditional on accepting a different vacancy.

nodes.speaker: JULIAN_VANE
nodes.text: Clause 2 — Northbridge conducts and documents a new assessment of the currently identified vacancies and reasonable reassignment options, including the advertised role and its actual qualification requirements.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Clause 3 — Daniel may submit a documented skills account, receive the vacancy descriptions used in that assessment, and comment on any factual errors before its conclusion.

nodes.speaker: JULIAN_VANE
nodes.text: Clause 4 — Northbridge gives Daniel a written reasoned outcome: which roles were examined, any positions offered, and the reasons for finding a role suitable or unsuitable.

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: Clause 5 — If you propose a different position, I receive its duties, pay, location and conditions in writing. I decide separately whether to accept it; this agreement does not accept it for me.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Clause 6 — For collective follow-up, Northbridge supplies UWF an appropriately minimised account of the review method and meets UWF to discuss the process after the reassessment, subject to lawful disclosure.

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Clause 7 — This package settles only the expressly identified dismissal-notice withdrawal and agreed review commitments. It contains no general release of unrelated claims or assertion that a disputed legal breach has been proven.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.text: Clause 8 — The record identifies which commitments belong to Daniel’s individual arrangement and which are agreed by UWF and Northbridge. Its legal classification depends on the actual parties, terms and written form.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: Clause 9 — Each commitment is marked proposed until the correct employer, UWF and, where relevant, Daniel authority is verified. Implementation is checked independently afterward.

nodes.speaker: VERA_JUSTICE
nodes.prompt: Which statement accurately describes this proposed package?

options.label: It separates withdrawal, individual reassignment decisions and collective process follow-up
It guarantees Daniel the advertised job and settles all possible claims
Signing proves Northbridge previously breached the law

nodes.speaker: LAURENCE_ABBOTT
nodes.text: Read the clauses again. The offer does not guarantee a vacancy, waive unrelated rights or adjudicate alleged misconduct.

nodes.speaker: SUP_DANIEL
nodes.text: I can consider that written package. But no one should mistake my willingness to consider it for my acceptance.

nodes.speaker: AUDREY_ORDER
nodes.text: We will seek Daniel’s informed instructions on the individual arrangement. Separately, the appropriate UWF decision-maker and Northbridge’s authorised signatory must approve any collective commitments.
